data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: Begin beside Vembanad Lake, where canals, paddy fields, birdlife, and village rhythms make water the first storyteller. Then climb gradually into the Cardamom Hills, trading humidity for spice-scented forests and cooler plantation air.

The route favours smaller properties, canoe-scale exploration, guided ecology, and spacious afternoons. Wellness can be woven in without turning the journey into a retreat programme, allowing nature and rest to remain the central rhythm.

data.title: Journey Standards & Inclusions
items: Lake-edge heritage stays and small eco-retreats with strong landscape relationships.
Private transfers designed to avoid unnecessary backtracking.
Naturalist and plantation hosts used where interpretation adds real value.
Wellness sessions arranged as optional additions rather than fixed daily programming.

data.title: Suggested Packing & Preparation
items: Light, quick-drying clothing for the backwater belt.
A breathable rain shell during shoulder and monsoon seasons.
Walking shoes with reliable grip for plantation paths.
A light sweater for highland evenings.
Swimwear and comfortable resort clothing for restorative stays.

data.quote: Kerala changes character with altitude, but the journey remains connected by water, shade, rain, and the generosity of people who live close to the land.
data.author: THE DESIGNER'S NOTEBOOK

data.title: MONSOON & WELLNESS NOTE
data.text: June to September can be deeply atmospheric for this route, especially for wellness-focused travellers. Expect heavy rain at times, slower road travel, and flexible outdoor scheduling.

data.title: A Landscape That Slows You Down
paragraphs: This is Kerala without the urge to cover everything. Water, forest, spice, and rest are allowed to occupy the time they deserve.
The result is a journey that feels restorative without becoming passive, with enough structure to understand the landscape and enough space to simply inhabit it.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Is this route suitable during the monsoon?
paragraphs: Yes, especially for travellers comfortable with rain and flexible outdoor plans. The landscapes are at their most intensely green.

items.question: Can Ayurveda be made a larger part of the journey?
paragraphs: Yes. We can add consultations and treatments while keeping the route balanced with nature and cultural experiences.

items.question: How much time is spent on boats?
paragraphs: Boat experiences are spread across the first half of the route and use smaller craft wherever possible for quieter waterways.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:
listItems: Chosen accommodation category and meal plan.
Confirmed guiding, hosted encounters, and ticketed experiences.
Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
